assignment_schema.reviewer_actor_id: canonical user_id; required when an authorized operator provisions a real reviewer
assignment_schema.assigned_gate_types: must be a subset of profile allowed_gate_types; source resolution uses profile operation
assignment_schema.assigned_candidate_ids: operational routing only until API-level candidate assignment enforcement exists
assignment_schema.effective_at: UTC instant; Identity membership effective_from remains authoritative
assignment_schema.expires_at: UTC instant; Identity membership effective_to is checked on production lookup, but current assignment API has no expiry input
